target.statement: DCFO achieves validity 1.00 on the sonar dataset (k=10), i.e., a valid counterfactual is found for every outlier

compute.basis: Small tabular dataset (~208 instances, 60 features); DCFO is a CPU SLSQP optimisation per outlier, runtimes in Table 9 are ~1.6 s/outlier, so a single-dataset validity cell is minutes of compute plus install/download overhead; main risk is re-implementing the region-based SLSQP algorithm from the paper if the anonymous repo is incomplete.

blockers: Anonymous.4open.science repo may be expired/incomplete; algorithm (region keys, FIFO restart, SLSQP) must be re-implemented from paper text if code is missing
Exact outlier selection/threshold rule (1.5 vs 95th percentile) and random k choice must be matched to reproduce the exact cell
title: DCFO: Density-Based Counterfactuals for Outliers -- Additional Material
